{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|It's not impossible. I used to bull's-eye womp rats in my T-16 back home. They're not much larger than two meters.|Luke Skywalker on the plan to destroy the Death Star|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Skyhopper.jpg|thumb|right|260px|A skyhopper on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]].]]
A '''skyhopper''' was any [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] designed to operate within a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Skyhoppers were commonly used as pleasure or utility craft, and were often [[Pilot/Legends|flown]] as racers by bush-pilots in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] owned an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] during his youth on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] was known to have kept an earlier model at his [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|father's]] [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Most of Skywalker's piloting ability in an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] was from his use of the skyhopper, since both craft were made by the same manufacturer and thus had very similar [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpits]] and controls.
